description_en: Changes the display name of a member, or switches the type of a member
description_zh: 调用UpdateAccount修改成员名称或切换成员类型
name: UpdateAccount

parameters.help_en:
The new display name of the member.

You can specify either `NewDisplayName` or `NewAccountType`
parameters.help_zh:
新的成员名称。
`NewDisplayName`与`NewAccountType`任选其一设置，不能同时设置
parameters.name: new_display_name

parameters.help_en:
The new type of the member. Valid values:

ResourceAccount: resource account
CloudAccount: cloud account

You can specify either `NewDisplayName` or `NewAccountType`
parameters.help_zh:
新的成员类型。取值：

ResourceAccount：将指定的云账号切换为资源账号。
CloudAccount：将指定的资源账号切换为云账号。

`NewDisplayName`与`NewAccountType`任选其一设置，不能同时设置
parameters.name: new_account_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks items such as whether the member status can be modified and whether security information is configured for the member. If the request does not pass the dry run, an error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改成员信息。检查项包括成员状态是否可以修改、成员是否具有安全信息等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误码。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改成员
parameters.name: dry_run

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member

AccountName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name of the member

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

JoinMethod.description_en:
The way in which the member joins the resource directory. Valid values:

invited: The member is invited to join the resource directory.
created: The member is directly created in the resource directory
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。取值：

invited：邀请。
created：创建

JoinTime.description_en: The time when the member joined the resource directory. The time is displayed in UTC

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was modified. The time is displayed in UTC

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

Status.description_en:
The status of the member. Valid values:

CreateSuccess: The member is created.
InviteSuccess: The member accepts the invitation.
Removed: The member is removed.
SwitchSuccess: The type of the member is switched
Status.description_zh:
成员加入状态。取值：

CreateSuccess：创建成功。
InviteSuccess：邀请成功。
Removed：已移除。
SwitchSuccess：切换成功

Type.description_en:
The type of the member. Valid values:

CloudAccount: cloud account
ResourceAccount: resource account
Type.description_zh:
成员类型。取值：

CloudAccount：云账号。
ResourceAccount：资源账号
